comment: The threshold is 1 - knob (SeventiesComp.cpp:46) and is compared against the rectified average of the inputs in volts, so even with the knob down most audio at ordinary levels is above it. The gain reduction is 1 / (1 + over * (ratio - 1)), which is a softer law than the stated 3:1 and 10:1 ratios (SeventiesComp.cpp:80). The panel prints Amount where the tooltip and the manual say Peak Reduction.
